headline: Frontlines Intensify Across Multiple Sectors
war_summary: Three hours after the last dispatch the war sharpens on several fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest sector, logging 39 ownership changes in the past day and a fresh toll of 10,218 Colonial and 10,957 Warden casualties while enlistments climb. Mooring County matches that tempo with 35 flips and 10,428 Colonial versus 10,285 Warden dead, its troop flow still rising. Stlican Shelf adds 14 changes centred on Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, pushing totals to 60,152 Colonial and 67,314 Warden losses. Palantine Berm erupts with 11 flips in the last six hours — the first notable activity there this war — driving its count to 3,425 Colonial and 4,368 Warden. Stonecradle records four recent flips around The Reach, lifting totals to 61,677 Colonial and 78,857 Warden. Farranac Coast, Linn Mercy and Nevish Line each note three changes, while the bulk of rear‑area regions stay quiet with no ownership moves reported.
